coverage_limits: Literal test names are matched from direct it/test/describe/suite calls and simple each(title) patterns; generated/computed names, aliased APIs, and complex nested each data expressions may be omitted.

Public API catalog includes package and example TS source with line-start exported declarations or route-like calls; it does not independently enumerate TSDoc comments, re-exports, or generated declarations.
Route-like call scan is syntactic and does not infer framework behavior.

definitions.changed_production_source_paths: Changed TypeScript/JavaScript source paths under packages/**/src/** or examples/**/src/**. The 6 changed scripts/** paths are listed separately; launch/deployment helper paths are inventoried in their own list and may overlap script paths.
definitions.public_api_source_files_catalogued: Tracked TypeScript/MTS files under packages/**/src/** and examples/**/src/** containing a line-start exported declaration or route-like app/router/server HTTP-method call. TSDoc comments are not independently parsed; re-exports and generated declarations may resolve contracts elsewhere.
definitions.changed_launch_deployment_helper_paths: Changed launch/deployment/config/helper files, including shell scripts, MJS helpers, Compose and Envoy YAML, and related configuration. This list is separate from source files, tests, and prose documentation; a helper may also appear in the changed scripts list.
definitions.changed_script_paths: Changed scripts/** TypeScript/JavaScript paths, listed separately from package/example src paths.
